gaps.quote: The last carry is written as the top bit.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the final carry can be written as a single top bit, but it never states or justifies that the carry is less than the base at the end. The reader cannot check from the page that the carry is at most 1 in general, so the output is not shown to be a complete binary string.
